C5 SCALAR-ALLOCATION OBSTRUCTION AND CORRECTED CENTRAL GLUING LEMMA
2026-10-09. Exact internal derivation. No novelty/external-validation claim.
Not a counterexample to C=2. The corrected local dual proves C=2 here.

1. THE FRAME AND ITS EXACT OPTIMAL ENVELOPE

Let C^5=S direct-sum C|4> direct-sum C|5>, with S=C^3. Use the vector
spin-one Ji on S, and define t=21/20,

 A1=tJ1 direct-sum 0_2, A2=J2 direct-sum 0_2, A3=J3 direct-sum 0_2,
 A4=D=diag(-7/5,-7/5,-7/5,2,11/5).

All four observables are Hermitian and traceless. Write Bi for the first
three restricted to S and

 Ls=diag(2,t^2+1,t^2+1),
 Gs=diag((2-t)^2,t^2,t^2)=diag(361,441,441)/400,
 Ks=Ls+Gs=diag(1161,1282,1282)/400.

Gs is the exact spin-envelope optimizer, with a matching pure ensemble
for I_3/3, by the frozen spin-support theorem. Put

 L=(Ls direct-sum 0_2)+D^2,
 G=(Gs direct-sum 0_2)+D^2,
 K=L+G=(Ks direct-sum 0_2)+2D^2.                                 (O1)

G is an exact full-frame optimum. Indeed, if a pure state has spin-block
mass r, its Bi score is r^2 f_B(phi)<=r <phi|Gs|phi>, since Gs>=0.
Also <D>^2<=<D^2>. This proves pure-state majorization by G. Conversely,
take the optimal spin ensemble with total mass 3/5, and |4>,|5> each
with mass 1/5. Its barycenter is I_5/5 and its score is Tr(G)/5.

The exact values are V=837/200, k=7131/2000, V-k=1239/2000,
and V+k=15501/2000.

2. EVERY SCALAR ALLOCATION FAILS, INCLUDING NON-DIAGONAL OPTIMA

Let W=sum_i Ai^T(A)(Ai(B)+Ai(C)). Consider the trace-correct ansatz

 D_alpha=alpha K_A^T+(1-alpha)(K_B+K_C)/2-W,                     (O2)

for any real alpha. In S^tensor3 take the normalized spin equality vector

 v=[4|111>-2|122>-2|133>
       +3(|212>+|221>+|313>+|331>)]/sqrt(60).

The central D contribution cancels exactly on this sector. Direct
substitution in (O2) gives

 <v|D_alpha|v>=(121alpha-67)/2400.

Therefore positivity requires alpha>=67/121. For the product vector
|4,5,5>, only D contributes, and

 <4,5,5|D_alpha|4,5,5>=2(11-21alpha)/25.

Therefore positivity requires alpha<=11/21. These inequalities are
incompatible: 67*21=1407>1331=11*121. Hence no scalar alpha works.
The spin constraint is a finite exact calculation, not an infinitesimal
or numerical inference. For general axial t near 1 its expectation is
(t-1)[alpha-3/5+(5+alpha)(t-1)/6], explaining the first-variation origin.

A different optimal envelope cannot rescue (O2). Twirl any

GENERAL ENVELOPE / LOCAL-DUAL INTERFACE
2026-10-09. Scoped internal derivation; no novelty or external validation claim.
Earlier frozen reports and source trees are preserved.

1. PURE ENVELOPE

For Hermitian Ai on C^d, f(psi)=sum_i <Ai>_psi^2, L=sum_i Ai^2,
V=tau(L), tau=Tr/d, and
k=max_{sum_y py pi_y=I/d} sum_y py f(pi_y), the exact envelope dual is

 k=min_G tau(G), subject to <psi|G|psi>>=f(psi) for every pure psi.   (I1)

One common pure ensemble is required. The feasible envelope G is PSD,
because f>=0. G=L is feasible by variance positivity. The feasible set
with trace bounded by Tr(L) is compact and closed, so a minimizer exists.
Equality of the two problems follows from compact moment duality, or
from a supergradient of the finite concave roof of f at the interior
state I/d. Thus an exact optimum G has tau(G)=k. G need not be unique.

2. THREE TRACIAL MARGINALS: NECESSARY AND SUFFICIENT LOCAL DUAL

Set W=sum_i Ai^T(A)(Ai(B)+Ai(C)). The stronger, all-tracial-state problem is

 h(W)=max_{R>=0, R_A=R_B=R_C=I/d} Tr(RW)
     =min_{X,Y Hermitian} tau(X+2Y)
       subject to X_A^T+Y_B+Y_C-W>=0.                            (I2)

Output exchange permits equal B,C dual variables Y. The full-rank
product state is strictly feasible for the primal, and a large scalar
local dual is strictly feasible. Finite-dimensional SDP strong duality
therefore applies; the local-dual interface is exact for this stronger
three-marginal problem. Neither X nor Y must be positive individually.

For C>0, V-k<=C(V-s) follows from any such local dual with

 tau(X+2Y)<=2[(1-1/C)V+k/C],                                      (I3)

because legal equal-output Choi states have Tr(RW)=2s. For C=2 the
budget is V+k. A proof of (I2) within that budget is stronger than the
original legal-channel gate: no pair self-adjointness is then required.
Failure of a restricted dual ansatz is not failure of this SDP or gate.

3. SCALAR ALLOCATION IS A RESTRICTED ANSATZ

With K=L+G_opt, a natural trial is

 D_alpha=alpha K_A^T+(1-alpha)(K_B+K_C)/2-W.                       (I4)

Its trace budget is exactly V+k for every real alpha. It need not be
positive. Frame-dependent alpha and a non-diagonal optimal G are allowed
when testing whether this ansatz might be general.

If a smooth two-sided family has D_alpha(0)>=0 with kernel E, positivity
for both signs of an infinitesimal perturbation forces
P_E D_alpha'
